name: source_line_105
value: The unweighted wage rate for Aircraft Pilots and Flight Engineers is $72.50.  BLS.  May 2017 National Industry-Specific Occupational Employment and Wage Estimates.  NAICS 481000 - Air Transportation. OCC 53-2010 Aircraft Pilots and Flight Engineers.  Last modified March 30, 2018 (accessed July 24, 2018), https://www.bls.gov/oes/2017/May/naics3_481000.htm.  TSA calculates a compensation factor by dividing the total compensation ($28.40) by the Salaries and Wages component of compensation ($18.77) to calculate a compensation factor of 1.51305 ($28.40 ÷ $18.77).  BLS.  Employer Costs for Employee Compensation - March 2018.  Table 5. Employer costs per hour worked for employee compensation and costs as a percent of total compensation: private industry workers. Production, transportation and material moving occupations.  Last modified June 8, 2018 (accessed July 24, 2018), https://www.bls.gov/news.release/archives/ecec_06082018.htm.  The fully-loaded wage rate therefore is the unloaded wage rate multiplied by the compensation factor. $109.70 = $72.50 x 1.51305.
